findings.summary: Vendor placement: commercial demo badge with tracking link in README, nobody asked for it
Badge would ship to PyPI long description and depend on third-party host
Badge directly above --- turns the horizontal rule into an H2 heading
Prettier pre-commit hook would rewrite the line
No CHANGES.md entry, so changelog check fails
Body claims about auto-rebuild and 'actual binary' can't be backed by the repo
Pitch reads as boilerplate outreach copy

why: Finding 1 objects to advertising a vendor's demo service in the README that the project doesn't ask for or maintain, which matches the maintainer's reason in substance.
